vector math, AngleVectors, VectorNormalize

playerState_t, usercmd_t, trace_t and flag constants
brush clip model, box trace, position test, point contents
player movement incl. wallwalk, pounce, jetpack, ladders, water
PM_SlideMove / PM_StepSlideMove / PM_PredictStepMove
inventory, trajectories, class/buildable queries over generated tables
entity storage, SV_Trace, frame loop driven by the systems sheet
G_Damage with locational modifiers (damage_regions sheet), radius damage, credits, player_die; every g_combat.c symbol final in symbols.tsv (G_SelectiveDamage has no caller in the C)
FireWeapon fn table (weapon_behaviors sheet); every g_weapon.c symbol Done (unlagged dropped, dec027)
one generic fire() over the missiles sheet; run, bounce, impact; every g_missile.c symbol Done
power, creep, think/die fn tables (buildable_behaviors sheet), G_CanBuild, G_Build, layouts and build log in layout.rs; every g_buildable.c symbol final
ClientThink_real, timers, events, spawning, spawn queues, gameplay commands; every g_active.c/g_client.c symbol final (unlagged dropped, dec027)
spawn counts, BP queues, stages, average players, exit rules

new: bots that only write UserCmds and use player commands (class/buy/sell/build/kill): nav-graph routes, ledge guard against deadly or damaging falls and lethal triggers, link blocking and wedge /kill, base guarding and grouped alien attacks, one builder per team (dec015, dec028)
IBSP v46 reader/writer + CM_LoadMap collision half incl. patches, inline models, visibility and brush edges; cm_load.c checksums dropped (no pure-server checks)
new: bot navigation graph: waypoints sheet, or directed walk/jump/drop links flood-filled over BSP floor, avoiding lethal triggers and lava, trap ledges pruned (dec015, dec028)
curved-patch collide generation, trace and position test (+ cm_polylib windings)
spawn vars + fields, G_CallSpawn, worldspawn, G_FindTeams, G_UseTargets/G_PickTarget/TeleportPlayer
pusher, doors, plats, buttons, trains, rotating/bobbing/pendulum
triggers, target_* (g_target.c), map decorations (g_misc.c), G_TouchTriggers
G_Physics/G_Bounce: buildables and corpses fall and bounce to rest
callvote/vote, G_CheckVote/G_ExecuteVote, evacuation/admitdefeat/suddendeath, G_BaseSelfDestruct
ClientCommand gating over the client_commands sheet, chat (G_Say), cheats, item commands
maprotation.cfg parser and rotation state machine (conditions, labels, goto/resume/return, nested rotations)
shrubbot admin system over the admin_commands sheet + g_namelog.c; host player is top admin, GUID-only bans (dec026)
ConsoleCommand and the Svcmd_* server console commands; EXEC_APPEND buffer (dec026)
layout files (save/list/select/load) and the build log with revert (dec026)
session data the host carries across map changes (restartTeam, ignore list)
R_MarkFragments / R_BoxSurfaces_r / R_ChopPolyBehindPlane over the BSP draw surfaces (faces, patch grids, triangle soups) for cgame mark polys; grids use the drawn tessellation (dec030)

G_LogPrintf (g_logFile / g_logFileSync / dedicated through world::Fs::append), every G_LogPrintf line of the C, LogExit, G_SendGameStat (logged: no master server), admin_log* / G_admin_authlog, ConcatArgsPrintable (dec027 superseded by dec031)
adaptive Huffman (Huff_Compress/Decompress of the connect packet) and the fixed netchan tree of MSG_initHuffman/msg_hData; bytes hashed against re/harness/net_ref (re/traces/net.sha256, dec033)
msg_t bit stream, strings, keyed usercmd delta, entityStateFields/playerStateFields deltas; bytes hashed against re/harness/net_ref (dec033)
Netchan_* (qport, challenge checksum, fragments), loopback, out-of-band packets, netadr_t and NET_StringToAdr/NET_Compare* of net_ip.c over a non-blocking UdpSocket (dec033)

the game module as the server engine reads it: entityState_t packing of the flattened gentities, BG_PlayerStateToEntityState, SV_LinkEntity clusters/areas and s.solid, BG_Pack/UnpackEntityNumbers, temp event and zap chain entities, the CS_* configstrings, ScoreboardMessage, TeamplayInfoMessage, print/chat/cp commands (dec033)

the server engine over the World: connectionless packets (getstatus/getinfo/getchallenge/connect/rcon), challenges, SV_DirectConnect, gamestate, configstrings, delta snapshots with PVS/area culling against the acked frame, usercmd execution, UDP downloads, rate control, timeouts, master heartbeats (dec033)

the client engine: CA_* connection state machine, challenge/connect, gamestate/snapshot/download parsing, usercmd packets with the keyed delta and reliable commands, CL_SetCGameTime, LAN/master server browser and pings, rcon (dec033)

the cgame of a networked client: snapshot processing and transitions, CG_PredictPlayerState with prediction error decay, entity interpolation, event entities and playerstate events, server commands and configstrings, written into a view World the presentation reads like the single-process one (dec033)
the unlagged system: per-frame client box history, rewind of the other players to the shooter's usercmd time for the weapon traces, collision detection after Pmove (dec033)
MD5 (MD5Init/Update/Final/Transform) and Com_MD5File for cl_guid from the qkey file; checked against the RFC 1321 vectors (dec033)

the networked part of Com_Frame (packet queue, SV_Frame, CL_Frame up to the cgame), the renderer-free engine commands of sv_ccmds.c and cl_main.c (heartbeat, serverinfo, systeminfo, killserver, localservers, globalservers, ping, serverstatus, rcon), Info_Print and the server/client cvar plumbing shared by the Godot host and the dedicated server (dec033)

the pure-server part of files.c and md4.c: Com_BlockChecksum, FS_LoadZipFile pak checksums from the zip central directory (checksum, pure_checksum keyed by fs_checksumFeed), the pk3 search path, pak references, FS_Loaded/ReferencedPak* strings, FS_PureServerSetLoaded/ReferencedPaks, FS_ComparePaks, FS_CompareZipChecksum, FS_FileIsInPAK; checksums hashed against re/harness/pak_ref (re/traces/pak.sha256, dec037)

client demos of cl_main.c / cl_cgame.c: CL_Record_f (gamestate rebuilt from configstrings and baselines), CL_WriteDemoMessage, CL_StopRecord_f, CL_DemoFilename, CL_PlayDemo_f / CL_WalkDemoExt (demos/<name>.dm_71), CL_ReadDemoMessage, CL_DemoCompleted with the timedemo statistics and cl_timedemoLog, the demo half of CL_SetCGameTime, cl_autoRecordDemo (dec037)

ioquake3 VoIP as tremulous-legacy builds it (USE_VOIP, Opus): CL_CaptureVoip / CL_VoipParseTargets / CL_Voip_f, CL_WritePacket clc_voipOpus, CL_ParseVoip with the bundled libopus 1.1 (crates/trem_opus, cc build), SV_UserVoip / SV_Voip_f / SV_WriteVoipToClient, sv_voip / sv_voipProtocol, Com_IsVoipTarget; sound I/O through VoipHost (dec037)

cl_avi.c AVI writer (RIFF header, MJPG / BI_RGB video and PCM audio chunks, idx1, 2 GB split check), CL_Video_f names, CL_Frame / S_GetSoundtime fixed frame and sound time while recording, RB_TakeVideoFrameCmd raw BGR layout; the index is kept in memory instead of the temporary .index.dat file (dec037)
the vanilla Tremulous 1.1.0 (protocol 69) adapter: 1.1 playerState shape, its enums, configstrings, server and client commands and usercmds mapped to and from the legacy client (re/source11, dec040)

the Tremulous 1.1.0 (protocol 69) wire: 1.1 entityStateFields/playerStateFields deltas, MSG_ReadString %-translation, Com_HashKey, CL_Netchan_Encode/Decode (re/source11; bytes hashed against re/harness/msg69_ref, dec040)
Tremulous 1.1.0 BG_Find* lookups over the classes11 / weapons11 / upgrades11 / buildables11 sheets, its inventory and packed ammo (re/source11, dec041)
Tremulous 1.1.0 bg_pmove.c + bg_slidemove.c on the 1.1 playerState, the prediction of a protocol 69 cgame; golden trace re/traces/arena11.sha256 from re/harness/pmove11_ref (re/source11, dec041)
STUN Binding request/answer (RFC 8489) sent from the game socket and taken out of NET_GetPacket before the Q3 path, for the host NAT check (port addition, dec076)
